sections.text:
# Cannon School — Branding — Athletics Logo

**Provenance:** Fetched by Claude on 2026-07-25 via web research, to add the school's
athletics mascot logo to the school-page header in the app.

- **School:** Cannon School (Concord, NC)
- **Mascot / teams:** Cougars
- **Athletic colors:** Maroon & gold
- **Logo used in app:** `public/logos/cannon.png` — primary Cougars mark (a maroon
 disc with a white cougar/panther silhouette). 1200×800 PNG, transparent background.
